publications.title: Data Augmentation for Dementia Detection in Spoken Language
publications.description: Dementia is a growing problem as our society ages, and detection methods are often invasive and expensive. Recent deep-learning techniques can offer a faster diagnosis and have shown promising results. However, they require large amounts of labelled data which is not easily available for the task of dementia detection. One effective solution to sparse data problems is data augmentation, though the exact methods need to be selected carefully. To date, there has been no empirical study of data augmentation on Alzheimer's disease (AD) datasets for NLP and speech processing. In this work, we investigate data augmentation techniques for the task of AD detection and perform an empirical evaluation of the different approaches on two kinds of models for both the text and audio domains. We use a transformer-based model for both domains, and SVM and Random Forest models for the text and audio domains, respectively. We generate additional samples using traditional as well as deep learning based methods and show that data augmentation improves performance for both the text- and audio-based models and that such results are comparable to state-of-the-art results on the popular ADReSS set, with carefully crafted architectures and features.

items.headline: Founder & CTO @ NetWit | Enterprise Agentic AI Architect (10M+ Daily Actions) | CISSP • Certified AI Professional (CAIP) • AWS AI | SOC 2/HIPAA Compliant AI | Serial Founder (15yrs) • Angel • Board Director
items.about:
Most companies don't have an AI problem. They have an architecture problem. Demos work. Production fails. The gap between "looks ready" and "survives at scale" is where enterprise AI initiatives go to die.



I built the cure.



As Founder & Senior AI Architect at NetWit, I architected the Enterprise Agentic AI OS — a production-grade multi-agent platform orchestrating 10M+ autonomous actions daily across healthcare, real estate, legal, logistics, and eCommerce. SOC 2 Type II/HIPAA/GDPR compliant. Not demos. Production.



THE PROOF:

• 10M+ agent actions/day and compounding

• 95% client retention (industry avg: 72%)

• Zero production incidents in 24 months

• 1,000+ automations deployed across 4 continents

• 30-person global team (Vancouver, Dubai, Bangalore, London)

• 13-year proprietary CPaaS — 99.9% uptime



CLIENT TRANSFORMATIONS:

→ Logistics unicorn: 40% faster lead response via AI WhatsApp/SMS — 200K+ leads

→ Healthcare: 60% less clinical documentation via multi-agent RAG — passed HIPAA first try

→ Real estate: 200%+ ROI on agentic campaigns — 65+ active clients

→ Legal: 80% contract review automation — $2M+ annual savings



I've built this over 15 years as a serial founder (3 ventures, bootstrapped from day one). The tech stack evolved from early marketing automation into what is now a proprietary Agentic AI OS with 8 specialized agents (Prospector, Qualifier, Outreach, Scheduler, Nurturer, Reporter, Support, Integrator) working in orchestrated multi-agent workflows.



Beyond NetWit: Board Director at The Skills Centre (Finance Committee Chair, 15% budget optimization, cybersecurity governance). ISC² CISSP. Angel investor backing pre-seed Agentic AI founders.



WHAT I DO NOW (High-Leverage):

→ FRACTIONAL AI ARCHITECTURE — Production agentic systems for $10M-$1B+ enterprises

→ AI STRATEGY & GOVERNANCE — Board advisory on AI risk, compliance, SOC 2/HIPAA readiness

→ ANGEL INVESTING — $25-100K checks into pre-seed Agentic AI / Vertical AI founders



Let's build something that survives production.

Book a strategy call → cal.com/dhiraj-netwit | dhiraj@netwit.ai | netwit.ai
